Title: Why We Started IrisGo | IrisGo Blog
# Why We Started IrisGo. March 30, 2026|Jeffrey, Co-founder & CEO, IrisGo. AI has made incredible progress. Models are smarter, faster, and more capable than ever. But one thing still feels broken:. **Getting real work done is still too hard.**. Most tools today are built around prompts. You ask, the AI answers. That works for questions, but real work isn't just a single prompt. It's a sequence of steps, spread across apps, shaped by context, and deeply personal to how each of us operates. And no model can reliably infer that from scratch. **That's why we started IrisGo.**. ## From Answers to Execution. We believe the next layer of AI isn't just about intelligence. IrisGo is built around a simple idea:. **Watch how you work, learn your workflows, and help you automate them.**. Instead of trying to guess what you want, IrisGo lets you show it once. From there, it turns your actions into reusable workflows that can run across applications. ## The Rise of Local Context and Skills. A key insight we've held from day one:. **AI becomes truly useful when it understands your local context.**. We're now seeing this idea validated more broadly, especially with the rise of projects like OpenClaw, which emphasize local execution and composable skills. This points to a bigger shift:. * ●From stateless interactions to persistent workflows. * ●From cloud-only to local, context-aware systems. ## Building the IrisGo Skills Ecosystem. This is why we're especially excited about what's coming next. **We're opening up 3rd-party skill integrations in IrisGo.**. Our goal is simple: enable a growing ecosystem of skills that can be learned, shared, and composed into real workflows. We don't believe automation should be locked inside a single model or company. The most powerful systems will be built together, by developers, by users, and by the community. We can't wait to see what you build. ## This Is Just the Beginning. But we believe we're at the start of a new layer in computing, one where software doesn't just respond, but learns and executes. Where your computer understands how you work. And helps you do it better. Thanks for being part of this journey.
